* '''Original''' ([[Mandalorian Armor (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip [[:File:VB5-13-Mandalorian_Armor.png]]): “Deploy on your alien of ability < 4. Character gains bounty hunter skill and immunity to attrition < 4. If character just hit, may place this device in Lost Pile (Used Pile if on The Mandalorian) to restore it to normal.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 13. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same text, writing “Immunity” with a capital I (capitals only, not a version).<ref name="cl-1250_15-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
